news.text: 🚨 Excl. - #Genk’s winger Ali #Camara (born in 2008) has agreed personal terms with #Juventus for a contract until 2029 + option. He will play for #Juve Next Gen and Primavera. #transfers[Nico Schira]
#Juventus have received some requests for Jeff #Ekhator, who could leave #Juve for one season loan to play more. Reflections Underway. #transfers[Nico Schira]

"#JUVE!"ACCORDING TO #KESSIÉThose phone calls and that meeting in Milan: deal down to the details.The bianconero club accelerates the timeline for Franck even without finding new places for #David and #Koopmeiners. The Ivorian could play in a 2- or 3-man midfield. #Sørloth is always in sight. At 1 PM, the Europa League opponents. #Elkann reassures #Yildiz.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🇨🇮🔛 "The hours of #Kessié continue: #Juventus remains confident and does not want to lose all the work done, both by the player and by the club. I wouldn't start sounding the alarm bells: as of tonight, work continues on the deal to balance the books for every step of this deal. The bianconeri are in control of the situation and hope to close the deal shortly."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

From Nottingham to Turin with Love 🤝As a nod to our shared history, our new away kit sees us adopt the original colours worn by Juventus before their switch to our enduring black and white.[Notts County FC]

#Kessie, it will be a night of contacts between #Juve and the Ivorian's agent to reach a full agreement. The midfielder wants the bianconeri and, also in recent hours, spoke with #Spalletti.#calciomercato[Eleonora Trotta]

🇳🇱🚫 "#Zirkzee was dropped by #Juventus because #Spalletti wants a striker with different characteristics, he has #Kessié as his priority and the bianconero management has therefore slowed down on the Dutchman, despite him being a priority for #Massara."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔚⁉️ "On the exits: #Rugani's agent was in Turin today, with #Parma showing interest in him. #Cabal, at the moment, is blocking all offers: there was the #Bologna lead, but he wants to play his cards at #Juventus, that nevertheless continue to look for a left-back. A solution also needs to be found for #David to unblock incoming moves in attack."[Ivan Oioli - SportItalia via @juventusinsidernews]

💸 "The current obstacle to close the signing of #Kessié to #Juventus lies in the payment schedule.#Juve intends to pay the agent's commissions (Atangana) and #Kessié's signing bonus in the third year (meaning, he plays two years and then they pay a large €5-6M bonus plus the prorated commission).However, the agent and the player want to collect that money immediately at the time of signing.Although the positions are close and there is optimism, total agreement on this point is still missing."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

✅ It has been an interesting day on the Franck #Kessie front for the first direct talks that took place between the #Juve management and his entourage.‼️Hot hours, the parties continue to negotiate. There is an agreement on the contract (2+1), but not yet on the signing bonuses. Negotiations are ongoing to try to find a breakthrough and close the deal in the coming hours.[Mirko Di Natale]

🇨🇮🆙 "#Kessié wants #Juventus at all costs. Regarding the overall package (signing bonus, commissions etc) something still needs to be sorted out. He is the priority for the midfield, he can't wait to join, but there is also an agent to satisfy. We are going forward and today in Italy there are only the bianconeri: all the rumors about other clubs had no reason to exist."[Alfredo Pedullà - SportItalia via @juventusinsidernews]

GJustjuve Exclusive: #Licina, there is also #Cremonese alongside #Avellino. And #Parma inquired. [Alfredo Pedullà] https://t.me/GJustjuve/72045ℹ️ #Juventus does not want to lose control of #Licina, they appreciate him a lot. There are many clubs trying to get him: #Avellino (they are also after #Sottil) and #Cremonese in Serie B, while there have also been inquiries from #Parma in Serie A and they will try to identify the best possible solution.[Alfredo Pedullà via @juventusinsidernews]
Exclusive: #Licina, there is also #Cremonese alongside #Avellino. And #Parma inquired.[Alfredo Pedullà]

🇨🇮‼️"Today #Kessié's agent met with #Juventus in a long meeting, where the bianconeri have made a proposal that has not been accepted at this moment: negotiations are therefore ongoing, there is still no agreement on the contract, bonuses and signing fee. We will see if the final 'yes' arrives overnight or if other clubs will have the opportunity to get back into the race."[Di Marzio - Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀🆙 "#Juventus, in the meeting with #Kessié's agent, made their desire to close and reach an agreement very clear, launching non-stop negotiations to finalize the details. After the exits of #Arthur, #Perin and #Miretti, the conditions are there to close the deal. Today the bianconeri maintain a privileged position and the situation gives reason to be confident."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
#Juventus, Ali #Camara has arrived in Turin. He will start with the #NextGen ⚪⚫🛬 @costantinovins[IlBianconero]

GJustjuve .@juventusfc-#Kessie, there is no agreement yet: they are continuing the negotiations @SkySport [Di Marzio] https://t.me/GJustjuve/72040ℹ️ #Juventus continues to negotiate for #Kessié: today there was a meeting with his agent, who has not yet accepted the bianconero club's proposal. #Carnevali and #Massara want to close immediately without having to wait , but for now, the agreement between the parties is still missing, and they will continue to negotiate in the coming hours following the latest contacts.[Di Marzio via @juventusinsidernews]
